item: second AI assessment and inter-assessor agreement

second.method: Codex read shopper-graded-v1 and the blinded test-split pool, then applied a strict evidence-only shopper-advocate interpretation. Missing required evidence was capped at grade 1. Existing grades were not used as grading input; serialization was deterministic after the AI decisions were made.

limits: Both assessors are AI; no human labels were created or claimed.
Kappa measures consistency, not accuracy or truth.
Only the 175 already judged test-split pairs were double-judged; coverage of the full dev+test pool is 50.72%.
The catalog and queries are generated/AI-authored, not real assortment or shopper traffic.
